Visiting Chefs

Our visiting chef program is one of our most unique initiatives at RIT Dining. We work with local restaurants and culinarians to bring authentic international cuisines to our campus community. You can find visiting chefs at various dining halls across campus, seven days a week.

Become a Partner

During one visit, your business will be exposed to over 5,000 students, faculty, and staff. Our visiting chef program is one of our most requested programs and operates out of our large restaurants for lunch and dinner. You’ll find our visiting chefs rotating between locations, days, and meal periods. We partner with local businesses who will bring a balanced and diverse food selection to campus.

If you want to join our visiting chef program, contact Herlan Manurung, corporate executive chef - associate director.
